dogecoin.text:
We've seen it all now! 

We now have a carrot and stick coin called Safemoon. 

Like Dogecoin, nobody knew of Doge until celebrities jumped in and promoted the meme.

This is different. To keep people from selling Safe they charge sellers 10%  and give back 5% to savers in coin!

Did you overstay your welcome?

Bitcoin was an early millionaire maker but this year's Dogecoin and Ripple's XRP coins went stratospheric. Then they fell, and are still falling.

The lesson, I think, is twofold. First, be greedy, but not too greedy. Secondly, sell and profit!
